data.name: Murakhas
data.gender_notes: Murakhas is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic root 'r-k-s', meaning to protect or guard. In Islamic context, a Murakhas is someone who shields and protects, a guardian or caretaker. It is a beautiful name for a child, evoking feelings of security and care. The name Murakhas carries the meaning “Protector, Guardian” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Murakhas usually hope their child will grow to embody protector, guardian and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A name imbued with protection and care.
data.etymology: Murakhas belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Protector, Guardian.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Murakhas total 2, giving a life-path number of 2. Number 2 is linked with Moon and with the qualities of harmony, sensitivity and partnership.

in_arabic.name: مرخس
in_arabic.meaning: اسم مشتق من مرخ ومعناه المريض أو المسرور
in_arabic.long_meaning: مرخس هو اسم مشتق من الفعل مرخ الذي يعني التمرخ أو التلطيف. وقد ورد في بعض التفاسير أن المرخس هو الشخص الذي يتم مرخه أي تطيبه وتليينه. وقد ذكر بعض العلماء أن هذا الاسم يعود إلى الجذر اللغوي مرخ الذي يحمل معاني التمرخ والتسهيل. ولهذا، فإن اسم مرخس يمكن أن يعني الشخص الذي يتمتع بالصحة الجيدة أو الذي يتمتع بالراحة والسرور.

in_urdu.name: مرخس
in_urdu.meaning: مرادف ہے مرخ کے جس کا مطلب ہوتا ہے بیمار یا خوش
in_urdu.long_meaning: مرخس ایک ایسا نام ہے جو مرخ کے فعل سے ماخوذ ہے، جس کا مطلب ہے التمرخ یا التلطيف۔ جنوبی ایشیائی مسلمانوں کے ثقافتی سیاق میں، یہ نام اکثر ایسے شخص کی خصوصیت کے طور پر دیکھا جاتا ہے جو صحت مند، آرام دہ، اور مطمئن ہے۔ اس کا تعلق قدیم عربی جڑ مرخ سے ہے، جو کہ لطف اور تلیین کے معنی رکھتی ہے۔

in_hindi.name: मरखस

in_english.name: Murakhas
in_english.meaning: Murakhas means a person who is healthy or happy
in_english.long_meaning: Murakhas is an Arabic-originated name derived from the root 'marakha', which means to be sick or to be happy. In Islamic tradition, this name is associated with a person who enjoys good health, comfort, and happiness. Historically, the name Murakhas has been used across various Muslim cultures to signify a person with a calm and peaceful demeanor. The name holds spiritual significance, reflecting the values of well-being and contentment.

In Islam, it is emphasized that every Muslim has a role in guarding and protecting the faith, the community, and the vulnerable. The name Murakhas serves as a constant reminder of our duty to protect and serve those around us, and to act as a barrier between harm and the innocent. It is a name that inspires us to live up to the noble qualities of patience, kindness, and selflessness, and to strive towards being guardians of the faith and guardians of the hearts of those we love.

historical_references.reference: Murakhas was a famous Sufi scholar and poet from the 14th century in Persia. He is known for his works on Sufism and Shams-e Tabrizi, and was a disciple of Amir Khusrow of Delhi.

historical_references.reference: Murakhas is also mentioned in the works of Ibn Arabi, a prominent 13th century Islamic philosopher and mystic, as a Sufi master of the Shadhiliyya order.
